extracted.name: Skiers’ French Toast
extracted.description: For this skiers’ French toast casserole, layer syrup, bread, and milk-egg batter the night before to bake the next day for a breakfast everyone loves.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 pound) loaf unsliced white bread, with crust trimmed
instruction_lines: Combine light corn syrup, butter, and sugar in a saucepan; simmer until syrup-like. Pour mixture over the bottom of a 9x13-inch pan.
Slice bread into 12 to 16 slices; place over the syrup. Layer as needed.
Beat together eggs, milk, vanilla, and salt. Pour over bread. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 350 degree F (175 degrees C).
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Cut into squares. Invert and serve.
